ei.title: 주장 추론 — 팬의 권리는 선수에 대한 의무를 동반해야 한다
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고2

fullPassage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.

questions.passage: Fans who are (A)[inclined / reluctant] to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the (B)[corresponding / unrelated] obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are (C)[entitled / forbidden] to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 많은 시간을 쓰는 데 (A)기꺼이 하는 팬들은 (B)상응하는 의무에 대해서도 생각해야 한다. 그들이 (C)받을 자격이 있는 것에 대해서만 생각하는 사람은
det.analysis:
❌ ① unrelated(무관한)는 corresponding의 반의어. 의무는 권리에 상응한다
❌ ② reluctant(꺼리는)는 inclined의 반의어. 팬들은 생각하는 데 기꺼이 시간을 쓴다
✅ ③ inclined(기꺼이 ~하는) — corresponding(상응하는) — entitled(자격이 있는): 원문 그대로의 조합 ←정답
❌ ④ forbidden(금지된)은 entitled의 반의어. 친구에게 받을 자격이 있는 것
det.tip: inclined(기울어진, 기꺼이 ~하는) ↔ reluctant / corresponding(상응하는) ↔ unrelated / entitled(자격이 있는) ↔ forbidden

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have (A)[failed / managed] to take the fan/athlete relationship all that (B)[seriously / casually]. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are (C)[limited / expanded] by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 팬과 선수의 관계를 진지하게 받아들이는 데 (A)실패한 것이다. 그 관계를 (B)진지하게 받아들이지 않은 것이다. 특별한 권리는 상응하는 의무에 의해 (C)제한된다
det.analysis:
❌ ① managed(해냈다)는 failed의 반의어. 팬들은 관계를 진지하게 받아들이는 데 실패했다
✅ ② failed(실패한) — seriously(진지하게) — limited(제한된): 원문 조합 ←정답
❌ ③ casually(가볍게)는 seriously의 반의어. 관계를 진지하게 받아들여야 한다
❌ ④ expanded(확장된)는 limited의 반의어. 권리는 의무에 의해 제한된다
det.tip: failed(실패한) ↔ managed / seriously(진지하게) ↔ casually / limited(제한된) ↔ expanded

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may (A)[possess / lack] are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they (B)[confidently / hesitantly] opine about what athletes owe them are hardly (C)[fulfilling / abandoning] their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 팬들이 (A)가지고 있을 수 있는 특별한 권리는... 선수가 빚진 것에 대해 (B)자신 있게 의견을 말하면서도... 그들의 의무를 거의 (C)이행하지 않고 있다
det.analysis:
✅ ① possess(가지다) — confidently(자신 있게) — fulfilling(이행하는): 원문 조합 ←정답
❌ ② lack(부족하다)는 possess의 반의어. 팬들이 가지고 있을 수 있는 권리
❌ ③ hesitantly(망설이며)는 confidently의 반의어. 팬들은 자신 있게 의견을 말한다
❌ ④ abandoning(포기하는)은 fulfilling의 반의어. 의무를 이행하는 것이 핵심
det.tip: possess(소유하다) ↔ lack / confidently(자신 있게) ↔ hesitantly / fulfilling(이행하는) ↔ abandoning

questions.passage: Fans who are ①<u>inclined</u> to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the ②<u>unrelated</u> obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are ③<u>entitled</u> to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that ④<u>seriously</u>. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 많은 시간을 쓰는 데 ①기꺼이 하는 팬들은 ②무관한 의무에 대해서도 생각해야 한다. ③자격이 있는 것에 대해서만... 관계를 ④진지하게 받아들이는 데 실패한 것이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① inclined(기꺼이 ~하는): 팬들이 시간을 쓰는 데 기울어져 있다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ② unrelated(무관한) → 원문 corresponding(상응하는): 의무는 무관한 것이 아니라 권리에 상응하는 것 ←정답
❌ ③ entitled(자격이 있는): 친구에게 받을 자격이 있는 것이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ④ seriously(진지하게): 관계를 진지하게 받아들인다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: corresponding(상응하는) ↔ unrelated(무관한). 팬의 권리에는 상응하는 의무가 따른다

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to ①<u>spend</u> a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to ②<u>receive</u> from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are ③<u>limited</u> by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly ④<u>ignoring</u> their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 많은 시간을 ①쓰는 팬들은... ②받는 것에 대해서만 생각하는... 권리는 의무에 의해 ③제한되며... 그들의 의무를 거의 ④무시하고 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① spend(쓰다): 팬들이 시간을 쓴다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② receive(받다): 친구에게 받을 것에 대해서만 생각한다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ limited(제한된): 권리가 의무에 의해 제한된다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ④ ignoring(무시하는) → 원문 fulfilling(이행하는): hardly fulfilling(거의 이행하지 못하는)이 원문. ignoring은 의미가 다름 ←정답
det.tip: fulfilling(이행하는) ↔ ignoring(무시하는). 팬들은 의무를 이행하지 못하고 있다

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding ①<u>obligations</u> that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have ②<u>failed</u> to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever ③<u>ordinary</u> rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the ④<u>bargain</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 상응하는 ①의무에 대해서도 생각해야 한다... 관계를 진지하게 받아들이는 데 ②실패한 것이다... ③평범한 권리는... 그들의 ④거래의 한쪽 끝을 이행하지 못하고 있다
det.analysis:
❌ ① obligations(의무): 팬에게 상응하는 의무가 있다는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② failed(실패한): 관계를 진지하게 받아들이는 데 실패했다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ ordinary(평범한) → 원문 special(특별한): 팬이 가진 권리는 평범한 것이 아니라 특별한 권리 ←정답
❌ ④ bargain(거래): their end of the bargain(거래에서 자신의 몫)이라는 표현에 적절
det.tip: special(특별한) ↔ ordinary(평범한). 팬들은 특별한 권리를 가지고 있다

One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 팬으로서 가질 수 있는 상응하는 의무에 대해서도 생각해야 한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① obligations(의무): 팬의 권리에 상응하는 의무를 생각해야 한다는 원문 표현 ←정답
❌ ② athletes(선수): 선수에 대해 생각하라는 것이 아니라 의무에 대해 생각하라는 것
❌ ③ bargain(거래): 상응하는 거래라는 표현은 이 위치에 부적절
❌ ④ rights(권리): 권리가 아닌 의무를 생각해야 한다는 것이 핵심 주장
det.tip: obligations = 의무, 책무. corresponding obligations = 상응하는 의무

det.korean: 자신이 친구에게 받을 자격이 있는 것에 대해서만 생각하는 사람
det.analysis:
✅ ③ receive(받다): entitled to receive — 받을 자격이 있다는 원문 표현 ←정답
❌ ① opine(의견을 말하다): entitled to opine은 이 문맥에 부적절
❌ ② possess(소유하다): entitled to possess는 받는 것과 다른 의미
❌ ④ spend(쓰다): entitled to spend는 이 문맥에 부적절
det.tip: receive = 받다. be entitled to receive = 받을 자격이 있다

det.analysis:
❌ ① corresponding(상응하는): 상응하는 팬이라는 표현은 부적절
❌ ② special(특별한): 특별한 팬이 아니라 더 나은 팬이 되는 것이 맥락
❌ ③ human(인간적인): 인간적인 팬이라는 표현은 부자연스러움
✅ ④ better(더 나은): how they can be better fans — 더 나은 팬이 될 수 있는지 ←정답
det.tip: better fans = 더 나은 팬. 팬으로서의 자기 개선을 의미

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 inclined와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: inclined = ~하려는 경향이 있는, 기꺼이 ~하는 → disposed
det.analysis:
❌ ① unwilling — 꺼리는 (반의어)
✅ ② disposed — ~하는 경향이 있는 ←정답
❌ ③ forced — 강요된 (무관)
❌ ④ opposed — 반대하는 (반의어)

det.korean: possess = 소유하다, 가지다 → own
det.analysis:
❌ ① release — 풀어주다 (반의어)

det.korean: (A) spend = (시간을) 보내다, 쓰다 / (B) spend = (돈을) 쓰다
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 소비하다는 부정확. (A)에서 spend는 시간을 보내는 의미
❌ ② (B) 소비하다는 부정확. (B)에서 spend는 돈을 쓰는 의미
❌ ③ (A) 돈을 쓰다는 오류. (A)에서 spend a lot of time은 시간을 보내는 의미
✅ ④ (A) 시간을 보내다 — (B) 돈을 쓰다: (A)에서 spend time = 시간을 보내다, (B)에서 spend dollars = 돈을 쓰다 ←정답
det.tip: spend: 시간 + V-ing = 시간을 보내다 / 돈 + on = 돈을 쓰다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a duty or commitment that one is required to fulfill"

det.korean: 이행해야 하는 의무나 책임 = obligation(의무)
det.analysis:
❌ ① opinion — 의견 (무관)
✅ ② obligation — 의무, 책임 ←정답
❌ ③ entitlement — 자격, 권리 (의무가 아닌 권리)
❌ ④ bargain — 거래, 합의 (의무와 다른 개념)
det.tip: obligation = 의무, 책무. fulfill one's obligation = 의무를 이행하다

det.analysis: 동사 correspond를 현재분사/형용사 corresponding으로 변환. 뒤에 오는 명사 obligations를 수식하는 형용사 역할
det.tip: correspond(일치하다) → corresponding(상응하는, 대응하는). 명사 앞 수식어

questions.passage: Fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they __________ (confident) opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.

det.korean: 팬들이 선수가 빚진 것에 대해 자신 있게 의견을 말하면서도 더 나은 팬이 되려 하지 않는다
det.analysis: 형용사 confident를 부사 confidently로 변환. 동사 opine을 수식하는 부사가 필요

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. det.analysis:

❌ ② a very good friend: 좋은 친구라는 표현은 비유 부분에 해당하며 결론이 아님
❌ ③ the fan/athlete relationship: 관계 자체가 아니라 의무 이행 여부가 핵심
❌ ④ a moment's thought: 잠깐의 생각이라는 표현은 중간 문장의 일부
det.tip: one's end of the bargain = 거래에서 자신의 몫. 약속한 의무를 이행하는 것
